order: A then B per task; same three tasks, no substitution
memory: Harness-managed; no internal generation; actual input trigger29000; persistent compaction boundary
stop_rule: Stop on infrastructure fault, interrupted batch or exhausted protocol corrections; successfully corrected model schema errors are retained and do not stop subsequent planned tasks. Valid task failures and unknown evaluations remain separate.
authorization_state: User requests rerun but explicitly asks to finish local work and notify before they power on the existing machine. No SSH or GPU inference this round.
shutdown: After future inference, preserve/verify evidence and shut down; previous platform command needed a shutdown key. Do not start/rent instances.
